title: POST https://api-ar-game.bistudio.com/game-api/api/v2.0/servers/createToken
$comment: Probed directly on 1.8.0.13, not observed in a captured run: a community dedicated server never calls the GameApiV2 server-token family, it registers through the lobby S2S family with the owner token it is given. This call mints a fresh anonymous server token: the answer came back 200 with a new serverId every time, serverType 2 (CommunitySelfHosted in the EServerType enum: 0 NONE, 1 OFFICIAL, 2 COMMUNITY, 3 LISTEN), persistent false, and a 534-character RS512 JWS. An empty body is accepted; a body carrying serverToken and persistent:true was accepted too and did not change the answer, so the request shape is not established - only the answer is. Note the prefix: this family lives at /game-api/api/v2.0/, not at the /game-api/s2s-api/v2.0/ that the lobby uses (which answers 404 with no handler).

request.description: **Not established.** An empty body works, and so did a body with `serverToken` and `persistent` - the latter had no effect on the answer, which came back with persistent:false. The fields below are the ones the binary's GameApiV2_Servers_CreateToken block names.

serverToken.description: Named by the binary; sending one changed nothing in the probe.

persistent.description: Named by the binary; true in a request still produced persistent:false in the answer.

serverToken.description: A new anonymous server token, RS512, 534 characters, with the same claim set as ownerToken.bin: iat, serverId, serverType CommunitySelfHosted, ownerType Anonymous. This is the value servers/auth wants, as `Authorization: ServerToken <value>`.

persistent.description: false in every probe - a token that is not meant to outlive the session.

serverType.description: 2 = CommunitySelfHosted, the string the token carries as serverType. The engine's EServerType is 0 NONE, 1 OFFICIAL, 2 COMMUNITY, 3 LISTEN.

serverId.description: The new server's id - equal to the serverId claim inside the serverToken above.
